proposals.name: Indie TTRPG (Tabletop Role-Playing Game) Creators & Players
proposals.buyer_persona: Creative indie game developers, Dungeon Masters, and players aged 18-45 who value unique, high-quality assets to enhance their games and stories. They are often budget-conscious but willing to pay for time-saving resources, and frequently use platforms like Itch.io, DriveThruRPG, and Reddit.
product_angles: Digital map tiles and assets (SVG/PNG) for virtual tabletops
Printable character sheets, rulebook inserts, and adventure journals (KDP low-content)
AI prompt packs for generating fantasy creatures, lore, or encounter ideas
proposals.first_test_product: Modular Fantasy Dungeon Map Tiles (SVG Pack) with basic creature tokens

proposals.name: Permaculture & Regenerative Agriculture Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: Environmentally conscious gardeners, small farmers, and homesteaders aged 25-60. They are dedicated to sustainable living, often DIY, and seek practical tools for planning, logging, and educating themselves about permaculture principles. Active in online forums, Facebook groups, and local workshops.
product_angles: Permaculture garden design templates and zone mapping icons (SVG)
Garden planning journals and harvest logbooks (KDP low-content)
Educational coloring books for kids on edible landscapes and biodiversity
proposals.first_test_product: My Permaculture Garden Planner & Logbook (KDP low-content)

proposals.name: Urban Exploration (Urbex) Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Photographers, adventurers, and history enthusiasts aged 18-50 who are fascinated by abandoned places. They prioritize respect for locations, safety, and documenting beauty in decay. They are active on Instagram, Reddit, and dedicated Urbex forums, seeking unique ways to express their passion.
product_angles: Stylized coloring books of abandoned architecture and industrial ruins
Digital photo overlays and graphic elements for Urbex photography (SVG/PNG)
Logbooks or journals for documenting exploration trips and locations (KDP low-content)
proposals.first_test_product: Abandoned Beauty: Urbex Coloring Book (stylized illustrations)

proposals.name: Local Historical Reenactment Groups & Living History Museums
proposals.buyer_persona: Organizers, educators, and volunteers of small historical societies, reenactment groups, and local museums. They need custom, authentic-looking digital assets for events, educational materials, and member engagement, often operating on limited budgets.
product_angles: Customizable historical event posters and flyer templates (SVG)
Educational coloring books depicting specific historical periods or local heritage (B2B direct sales)
Digital asset packs for social media: historical patterns, crests, weapon silhouettes (SVG)
proposals.first_test_product: Medieval Faire Activity Coloring Pack (B2B, sold to local groups)

proposals.name: Amateur Astronomy & Astrophotography Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Individuals aged 25-65 with a deep passion for the cosmos, owning telescopes, and often engaging in astrophotography. They seek tools for planning observations, logging discoveries, and showcasing their interest. Active in astronomy clubs, forums, and online communities.
product_angles: Deep-sky object logbooks and observation journals (KDP low-content)
Stylized constellation maps and celestial event calendars (SVG)
Coloring books featuring nebulae, galaxies, and planetary scenes
proposals.first_test_product: Deep Sky Object Observation Logbook (KDP low-content)
